design_principle: Evaluate evidence addition against each native task outcome without constructing a universal triage target.

t4_experiment.permitted_question: Can native T5 duplicate evidence improve the T4 native assignee decision when evaluated against target_assignee?
prohibited: convert t5_p_duplicate into an assignee probability
multiply or add T4 scores by t5_p_duplicate

t5_experiment.permitted_question: Can native T4 retrieval evidence improve the T5 native duplicate decision when evaluated against T5 target?
prohibited: convert T4 ranking into duplicate probability

stability_warning.statement: T5 development positive count is small; any learned T5-side evidence-addition mechanism may be unstable and must be interpreted conservatively.
